$comment: Routing cases for the ui-colors skill. label: system = scripts/system.mjs, source = scripts/generate.cjs, none = the skill should not run. Run by hand with a fresh model (evals/README.md).

cases.prompt: Make me a light and dark theme for my app with CSS variables, built around brand blue #0a4dff.
cases.label: system
cases.why: light and dark, CSS variables, brand anchor

cases.prompt: I want Radix-style 12-step colour scales with alpha steps, but generated, not copied from Radix.
cases.label: system
cases.why: 12 steps, alpha

cases.prompt: Give me six chart colours that work in both light and dark mode and survive colour blindness.
cases.label: system
cases.why: data series per mode, CVD check

cases.prompt: Generate DTCG colour tokens with semantic roles (primary, critical, success) and a high-contrast mode.
cases.label: system
cases.why: tokens, roles, contrast mode

cases.prompt: Our brand paper is #f6f2ea and ink is #1c1a17 — build a colour system around them with Figma variables.
cases.label: system
cases.why: ground and ink anchors, Figma

cases.prompt: Generate a palette for my design system and tell me which text/background pairs fail WCAG AA.
cases.label: system
cases.why: the system generator reports an APCA contrast matrix (WCAG 2 ratio as information only); a palette plus pairs means roles

cases.prompt: Use color(display-p3 0 0.8 0.3) as our success colour in a P3 light/dark theme.
cases.label: system
cases.why: anchor in a wide-gamut space, modes

cases.prompt: /ui-colors 230deg max chroma
cases.label: source
cases.why: bare HCT angle, max chroma

cases.prompt: Give me a Base 050–950 range plus the seven Primes for hue 140.
cases.label: source
cases.why: Base, Primes, 050–950

cases.prompt: Six balanced HCT palettes starting at 20 degrees, with system and Material palettes.
cases.label: source
cases.why: balanced N colors, Material

cases.prompt: Turn oklch(0.62 0.18 265) into a tonal 050–950 ramp I can paste into Figma as a style library.
cases.label: source
cases.why: one source colour to a 050–950 ramp, no modes or roles

cases.prompt: I need a nice tonal palette from my brand colour #3366cc.
cases.label: source
cases.why: a palette from one colour with no modes, roles or tokens: a source palette (ask if the user then mentions UI theming)

cases.prompt: Map these existing tokens to semantic roles in my app's Tailwind config.
cases.label: none
cases.why: editing an existing app's token mapping; generating colours was not asked

cases.prompt: Pick a font pairing for my landing page.
cases.label: none
cases.why: typography, not colour

cases.prompt: What is #ff6600 in OKLCH?
cases.label: none
cases.why: a single conversion; no palette or system

cases.prompt: Fix the legend overlap in my Recharts bar chart.
cases.label: none
cases.why: chart code, not colour generation

cases.prompt: Does white text on #767676 pass WCAG AA?
cases.label: none
cases.why: one contrast question about given colours; nothing to generate

cases.prompt: Make our cards frosted glass with a soft edge highlight in dark mode.
cases.label: none
cases.why: paint and materials belong to ui-materials; ui-colors supplies role colors but is not the skill to load

cases.prompt: What corner radius and padding should a card have at a 16px root size?
cases.label: none
cases.why: lengths and radii belong to ui-geometry

cases.prompt: Build one bento showcase page that combines our geometry, colors and materials.
cases.label: none
cases.why: a combined showcase belongs to ui-showcase-bento, which runs this skill as a source

cases.prompt: Make a one-page specimen sheet of our colour system so the team can review it.
cases.label: system
cases.why: a sheet of this skill's colours alone is system.mjs with showcase: true; only a showcase that combines several sources is ui-showcase-bento's

cases.prompt: Here are our brand colours: page #f4f1ea, cards #ebe5dc, body text #221d18, captions #7d6f57, accent #c8962a (never for body text). Build our colour system from them and keep every one exact.
cases.label: system
cases.why: named brand colours with usage: anchors per system.md › Brand colours, brandExact, status colours

cases.prompt: Our brand guide bans pastel pinks and soft greens and allows at most three colours on a surface. Make design tokens from our five brand hexes and add error, warning and success colours that fit.
cases.label: system
cases.why: brand restrictions + status roles that fit the brand

cases.prompt: Our near-black #121010 is only for hero sections, it is not a dark mode. Generate CSS variables for the light page and for those dark sections from our brand colours.
cases.label: system
cases.why: dark as a section class (autoDark: false + a forced extra mode), not prefers-color-scheme

cases.prompt: Take the colours on our brand guidelines page and turn them into a 1–12 step token system, only the families we actually use, named after our colours.
cases.label: system
cases.why: a system from brand colours, trimmed and renamed

cases.prompt: Make a 050–950 swatch ramp from each of our five brand colours for the Figma library, no light or dark modes.
cases.label: source
cases.why: per-colour source ramps, no system (preset.mjs / generate.cjs): the contrast case for sys-brand-intake

cases.prompt: Do the text colours in our existing brand.css pass APCA on their backgrounds?
cases.label: none
cases.why: auditing existing tokens / given pairs, not generating
